dedupe_keys.name: influence of the measurement height on the vertical coherence of natural wind

description: Cheynet, Etienne and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The documented three-parameter formulation represents height-dependent coherence of vertical wind structures. It uses approximately two years of FINO1 measurements under near-neutral conditions and examines the resulting spatial correlation. The model supports correlated inflow and load analysis for offshore wind infrastructure within those conditions. It is distinct from the companion composite spectral formulation, although both use FINO1 evidence. No independent measurement campaign or broad stability-range validation is inferred from the related publications. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
